question: Should ClickClack make Channels, Direct messages, and People independently collapsible and persist those choices per workspace in browser localStorage?
rationale: Current main defines only whole-sidebar collapse, so persistent per-section disclosure is a new product and UX contract rather than a correction to established behavior.

options.title: Accept persistent disclosures
options.body: Keep all sections expanded by default and remember each workspace's explicit section choices in the browser.

options.title: Use session-only disclosures
options.body: Add the controls but reset section state on reload to avoid creating another persisted preference surface.

options.title: Retain current navigation
options.body: Decline per-section collapse and continue supporting only whole-sidebar collapse.

recommendation.title: Accept persistent disclosures
recommendation.body: Keep all sections expanded by default and remember each workspace's explicit section choices in the browser.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent merged history in Sidebar and ChatApp navigation integration.
